what: Plan maps CI job lint to make lint but CI runs make lint-only
scenario_or_breakage: Local per-job loop can pass make lint while the remote lint job (lint-only + SKIP hooks) still fails; fixes do not mirror the failing job
suggested_fix: Change the mapping table and tests to use make lint-only (and document the SKIP hook split vs dedicated jobs)

what: Skipping run_ci_fix_vendor when the per-job loop succeeds drops run_checks_with_lint_fix_loop
scenario_or_breakage: Push path no longer runs the existing relevant-checks gate that today always runs after a successful vendor fix; regressions agent-lint pre-commit only catches later
suggested_fix: After per-job success either call run_checks_with_lint_fix_loop once before _stage_and_push_ci_fixes or document and accept the weaker gate explicitly in ship-pr.md

what: Plan treats empty checks log plus lint-fix-loop exit 0 as _RCC_STATUS ok for a failed captured command
scenario_or_breakage: If the mapped command fails with no stdout stderr the redacted log is empty lint-fix-loop exits no-changes 0 and the helper can wrongly treat the job as fixed
suggested_fix: Teach run_captured_cmd_then_fix_loop to re-run the command after no-changes or treat empty log plus failing rc as exhausted or inject a one line synthetic failure log before dispatch

what: Drift pin regex ^ [a-z][a-z0-9_-]+:$ matches on: keys not jobs
scenario_or_breakage: List includes workflow_dispatch pull_request push so the harness fails or needs bogus map entries unless scoped
suggested_fix: Parse only lines after a jobs: sentinel or match job ids via a maintained allowlist from ci.yaml

what: New scripts test-ci-failed-jobs.sh is not auto registered
scenario_or_breakage: New harness dead script or unreferenced test warnings fail agent-lint pedantic until toml and Makefile comments match repo pattern
suggested_fix: Add scripts test-ci-failed-jobs.sh and sibling md to agent-lint.toml with the same Makefile-only note pattern as test-gh-run-logs

what: Plan uses eval on LOCAL_CMD from parsed gh output
scenario_or_breakage: Job names are usually trusted but eval expands shell syntax if gh ever echoed unexpected content
suggested_fix: Avoid eval; invoke via a case table of allowed make targets or bash -c with a fixed wrapper per job class

what: Plan says head-changed maps to exit_stall like today
scenario_or_breakage: Today head-changed-after-dispatch yields lint-fix-loop rc 1 run_checks returns 1 run_ci_fix_vendor returns 1 and the outer loop retries with backoff not a dedicated exit_stall
suggested_fix: Align ship-pr.md and plan prose with actual record_failure plus outer retry behavior or add explicit head-changed handling if stall was intended
